scope: Executed finite support/arithmetic falsification and analytical logic witnesses; not a proof under the full target hypotheses or a Lean certificate

free_wave.result: Agreement only on terminal observation set cannot replace initial backward-cone agreement. Identical initial displacements do not suffice when velocities differ.

same_law_witness.example: G and -G for a nondegenerate centered real Gaussian G
same_law_witness.fact: Same law, yet unequal with probability1
same_law_witness.result: Equal-law source definitions alone cannot give a same-realization cutoff identity. This is an abstract logical witness, not a counterexample under same-W convergence hypotheses.

operator_topology_boundary.example: Orthogonal projection onto nth coordinate of l2
operator_topology_boundary.fact: Strongly tends to0 on each fixed vector but operator norm remains1
operator_topology_boundary.result: Do not relabel statewise convergence as operator-norm convergence; the proposed operator-norm assumption is sufficient, not claimed necessary.
